meta.name: writing-livekit-scenarios
meta.description: Creates and maintains the scenarios a LiveKit agent simulation runs, and wires the agent to consume them. Use when the user asks "what should I test", "generate simulation scenarios", "write scenarios for my agent", "add a scenario for X", "organize my scenario files", "my simulations are flaky", "the scenario hits my real database", "seed state per scenario", "it passed but booked the wrong thing", "grade the final state", or wants to stress-test a flow before shipping. Covers generating a baseline with the LiveKit scenario generator and refining it, writing the cases generation misses, phrasing simulated-user instructions so they steer reliably, splitting scenarios into sets across files, and the agent-side code that seeds deterministic state from a scenario and fails a run on its final state. To run them use running-livekit-simulations.
